title: [Bug 646487] Composite layout: focus fix, body-layout gating, and setup UI
summary: Multiple bugs in composite layout management are fixed, including focus handling, multi-select deletion, configuration key conflicts, and layout subtype restrictions. UI labels are clarified and a Details FactBox replaces the Theme and Header/Footer Box.
key_points: Focus now moves to the newly created theme or header/footer part
Multi-select delete now removes all selected parts and skips out-of-box parts
Configuration rows are keyed by the composite layout reference and created with a complete key, so they no longer collide or get rejected
Theme and header/footer assignment is limited to body layouts in the UI
A new Details FactBox replaces the Theme and Header/Footer Box, and the configuration page explains each row's scope in words
quote: focus not moved to the newly created part.
